description: Predict EVM contract addresses before deployment: CREATE (deployer + nonce, RLP-encoded; up to 50 consecutive nonces) or CREATE2 (deployer + salt + init code or its keccak256 hash, EIP-1014). Works for every EVM chain; returns EIP-55 checksummed addresses. No network calls. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/evm-create-address

count.description: CREATE: how many consecutive nonces to list

initCode.description: CREATE2: init code hex (alternative to initCodeHash, max ~1.9 KB in a URL)

initCodeHash.description: CREATE2: keccak256 of the init code (0x + 64 hex)

nonce.description: CREATE: account nonce of the deployer (contracts start at 1)
